payload.question: How much outside money did the council bring into the city?
payload.label: External funding brought in against target, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: A single very large award can swing this figure enormously — the previous year's total was £463,086. Treat one year on its own with care. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council sets itself a target of bringing in £250,000 a year of outside funding for development and regeneration. In 2024/25 it reported £42.7m. This indicator has no intervention level published, so the general target rule applies.
